exercises.question: Choose the grammar pattern that matches: "Better not to [Verb]".

options.text: A とか B とか
A は B ほど～ありません
A は B ほど～ない

exercises.correctFeedback: Great! Verb ないほうがいい matches "Better not to [Verb]".
exercises.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. The correct pattern is Verb ないほうがいい.
exercises.explanation: Used to advise that not doing something is the better choice.
